title: FiveToken
tagline: to bridge Filecoin ecosystem to Web 3 metaverse with reliable ID management
how_its_made: FiveToken used cross-chain payment protocol to leverage BSC, ETH, Dfinity and other impactful blockchains to the App and design the solution for encrption and storage of private key and compatibility solution of mnemonic words that supports multiple chains. Based on that, we leverage IPFS to complete the store and retrieve ID information in our Web 3 version App.
